name: Toenec Corporation
summary: Toenec Corporation engages in facility construction work in Japan. It operates through Equipment Installation Business, Energy Business, and Other segments. The company engages in the undertaking and carrying out of indoor wiring, air conditioning plumbing, and communication line work; FIT solar power generation business; PPA services; and high-voltage bulk power receiving services. It is also involved in facility management; construction and maintenance of power distribution lines; construction of underground power distribution lines, solar power plants, and distribution routes; air conditioning duct work; installation of indoor electrical equipment, base stations for mobile communications,…
